Episode Notes:
Fighting escalated in the Strait of Hormuz this week, and the Houthis in Yemen captured more coastal territory, increasing their ability to threaten the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. Kerry talks with Rachel Ziemba about the current situation in both straits, the effects on shipping, and the impacts on the global economy, particularly the oil trade.
